package.name: mdrobot_imu
package.description: Publishes a WITMOTION HWT901B attitude sensor as sensor_msgs/Imu. Attitude only: it exists so the machine's yaw and tilt are visible once it is under a vehicle and nothing can see it, not to estimate position — integrating this accelerometer over a blind entry is worse than the wheel odometry it would replace. Shares the robot with the motor bus, not the bus itself.
